title: The Vanishing of Flight 370
summary: LEMMiNO's 25-minute documentary on the 2014 disappearance of Malaysia Airlines Flight 370. It walks through the official investigation's findings and the leading theories, including satellite data and hydrophone recordings.
why: Regularly shared as the best well-made overview of the MH370 mystery, in threads on the search and ocean mapping.

quote.text: There is a really well put together video[1] by a YouTuber, who goes by the name of Lemmino
